name: WPA System of Connected Vessels
principle: One verified input may flow to every eligible WPA system, but only with provenance, bounded purpose, version discipline and the applicable Human Gate.
principle_mk: Еден проверен влез може да се пренесе до секој соодветен WPA систем, но само со доказно потекло, ограничена намена, верзиска дисциплина и применливата Човечка порта.
formula: Signal -> Source Compliance -> Evidence -> Institutional DNA / WPA Knowledge Object -> Governed Routing -> Eligible WPA Systems -> Human Gate where required -> Application / Publication -> Measurement -> Correction -> Knowledge Reintegration

always_on_semantics.meaning: 24/7-ready means scheduled monitoring, queueing, validation and routing may run without a human continuously present where technical infrastructure and lawful source access are active. It does not mean that all agents, social APIs or external platforms are continuously connected or autonomously publishing.

vessels.name: Public Signal Vessel
vessels.role: detect public signals and create source-checkable candidates
vessels.boundary: No surveillance, private tracking, access-control bypass or prohibited scraping

vessels.name: Evidence Vessel
vessels.role: verify provenance, identity, context, uncertainty and correction state

vessels.name: Institutional DNA Vessel
vessels.role: turn verified institutional practice into reusable, source-traceable knowledge objects

vessels.name: Research and Editorial Vessel
vessels.role: route verified knowledge into research questions, comparative analysis and editorial candidates without automatic acceptance

vessels.name: Learning and Practice Vessel
vessels.role: reuse approved patterns as teaching structures, scenarios, examples and practice questions

vessels.name: AI and Orchestration Vessel
vessels.role: coordinate discovery, synthesis, routing, QA and bounded production without inheriting final institutional authority

vessels.name: Public Communication and Social Vessel
vessels.role: prepare and distribute human-approved public communication across official WPA channels
vessels.boundary: Automatic external publishing requires separately authorised official platform adapters and credentials; absent those, the vessel prepares queues and human-share actions only.

vessels.name: Trust, Measurement and Correction Vessel
vessels.role: measure outcomes, process corrections, propagate material changes and return lessons to the knowledge corpus

governed_handoffs: A signal may become evidence only after source-compliance checks.
Evidence may become a reusable knowledge object only with source identity, retrieval date, context and uncertainty preserved.
A knowledge object may enter multiple WPA domains, but each downstream use must respect its approved reuse status.
Public communication candidates may be generated automatically; consequential or reputational publication remains human-governed unless a separately approved bounded publication mandate exists.
A correction, source withdrawal or material contradiction must be routed back to every reasonably traceable dependent output.
No vessel may silently widen the mandate of another vessel.

social_integration.listening_rule: Use only official APIs, authorised feeds, public pages where automated access is permitted, or human-supplied public material. Do not bypass platform controls.
social_integration.publishing_rule: No automatic posting until the relevant official platform adapter, credential scope, security review and Human Gate policy are verified.
social_integration.cross_platform_rule: One approved WPA knowledge object can generate platform-specific draft variants while preserving the same source trace ID and factual core.

knowledge_reuse.rule: Institutional DNA is a whole-Institute input, not an Index-only asset.

human_gate.HG0: Informational routing, local validation and reversible candidate preparation may be automated.
human_gate.HG1: Bounded scheduled monitoring and queue maintenance may run under a preapproved mandate.
human_gate.HG2: Consequential external institutional communication, scoring release or reputational publication requires attributable human approval unless a separately approved bounded policy explicitly permits the exact action.
human_gate.HG3: Credentials, private data, payments, formal assessment records and sensitive backends require approved secure infrastructure and human preapproval.
human_gate.HG4: Doctrine, institutional mandate, new authority and official commitments cannot be finally decided by machines.

non_claims: 24/7-ready does not mean every external API is currently connected.
No claim that 17 plus 80 agents are continuously executing at all times.
No automatic social posting is claimed without verified platform credentials and adapters.
No surveillance, intelligence, private tracking or prohibited scraping function.
No autonomous ranking, accreditation, credential or legal authority.
